name: Store-cluster transactions at the control-store baseline
question: If S03-S05 had followed the matched control stores' YoY path from their own pre-period level
assumptions: Control stores show what the cluster would have done; the cluster's H1 gap to the controls would have persisted; DiD pre-trend flat (checked).
confidence: High for the size (robust across control groups and windows; placebo p 0.0015, the smallest attainable); cause unresolved

name: All stores' H2 transactions at their own H1 YoY trend
question: If every store's H2 receipts had changed YoY as its H1 receipts did
assumptions: H1 YoY transaction trend continues into H2; AOV, return rate and margin rate as actually observed in H2 per store.
confidence: Low: H1 trend is a simple extrapolation

name: Electronics availability at the prior-year baseline
question: If full-week stock-outs had stayed at the prior-year level
assumptions: Lost demand = baseline expected sales in full-week stock-outs; no substitution; margin at the category line-margin rate. Range = sensitivity variants, including the estimate net of deferred demand recovered after stock returned (EUR 13,272). The BR-05 upper bound incl. partial weeks (EUR 100,411) is not evidence and is not used.

name: Returns at the prior-year return rate
question: If every store had refunded the prior-year share of its sales
assumptions: Prior-year return rate by value applied to current sales (arithmetic, no range). Of this, Electronics 'Faulty' returns at their prior-year level account for EUR 31,589.
confidence: High for the arithmetic; it says nothing about why returns rose

name: Home & Kitchen promotional behaviour comparable with the prior year
question: If H&K had kept the prior-year discount rate and relative performance
assumptions: Central = M1 category DiD (H&K vs control categories in the same store-weeks). Range includes M4 (discount rate) and the M2 / M3 methods that point the other way.
confidence: Low to medium: methods disagree in sign (see sensitivity)

name: Combination of the mutually exclusive components
question: Sum of the exclusive attribution components (cluster excess, stock-outs, 'Faulty' returns, H&K), after removing any overlap with the cluster excess
assumptions: Components are exclusive by construction (overlap.py); the residual is not attributed.
confidence: As weak as its weakest component (D)
